The <b>Twisted Bud</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverable|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The <b>Twisted Bud</b> can be given to [[Greyroot]] in [[Shellwood]] to start and complete the <i>[[Rite of Rebirth]]</i> wish. 

Completing this wish leads to the <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> wish, begun by speaking to [[Yarnaby]] in [[Greymoor]].

The Twisted Bud produces a constant cry while the inventory is open, which can also be heard on adjacent screens of the menu.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Greyroot.png!Location in Shellwood
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Greyroot 02.png!Greyroot in Shellwood
}}

== Curse ==
{{Main|Cursed Crest}}
After finishing the <i>[[Rite of Rebirth]]</i> wish by giving [[Greyroot]] the Twisted Bud, the bud subsequently infests Hornet's shell and curses her. 

While [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is cursed, the Silk Spool is limited to 3 strands, preventing the usage of [[Bind]] and [[Silk Skills]]. She is also forced to use the [[Cursed Crest]] and cannot change it. The Cursed Crest prevents usage of any tools at all, including ones equipped in the [[Vesticrest]].

Completing the <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> wish frees Hornet from the curse and grants the [[Witch Crest]].

The [[Achievements (Silksong)|Twisted Child Achievement]] is awarded for defeating [[Grand Mother Silk]] while cursed.

== How to Acquire ==
The Twisted Bud can be found in [[Bilewater]], in a crib-like root. This area is accessed by falling from a hidden passage in the easternmost side of [[Whispering Vaults]]. This area cannot be accessed from other entrances into Bilewater, as the room has a gate that is opened from above.

== Trivia ==
* Going off its internal name, the Twisted Bud is based on a [[wikipedia:Mandrake|mandrake]], a real life species of toxic plants.
** In European folklore, mandrakes are believed to be sentient, and would cry if uprooted from the ground, similarly to the Twisted Bud.
* If the [[Needolin]] is played for the Twisted Bud while it is still in its "crib," the Bud whimpers quietly instead of loudly crying. Once the playing stops, it resumes wailing.
